groups.intro: Deferred by the owner on 2026-08-31; each item returns with its trigger.

items.text: Publishing path (GitHub remote with `npx github:jblossey/houserules`, or npm). Trigger: the owner's ruling on docs/design.md §5.3. Prerequisite HR-001; the `files` whitelist is done.

Adoption path for tag-pilot. Trigger: the first houserules release or publish (raise with decision 3; re-deferred 2026-09-01 after PR #42 merged). Until then tag-pilot stays the upstream of the kit-owned files; diff tools/, .claude/agents/, .claude/skills/ against template/ before every release and port the drift.
A Claude Code plugin as a complement for the static agent templates and the orchestrating skill (docs/design.md §3). Trigger: a second adopter that wants central updates.

groups.intro: Parked by the owner's Tier 2 ruling of 2026-09-03 (HR-047/HR-048: the compiled-binary rewrite, no interim tiers).

items.text: Tier 0/1 distribution alternatives from the owner-launched analysis: version managers carrying Node (asdf plugin with a Node prerequisite, mise npm: backend post-publish, a mise registry entry), and the tier 1 path (fold kb.mjs/backlog.mjs into CLI subcommands with thin POSIX shims, then Node SEA / deno / bun compiled binaries from the JS codebase). Superseded: the owner ruled Tier 2 direct. Kept for the record; the tag-format prerequisite moved into HR-048. Trigger: only a reversal of the Tier 2 ruling.
